english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: AMD reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5B, up 50% YoY, with Data Center revenue more than doubling to $6.7B. Reuters reported shares fell nearly 9% after hours despite beating estimates, as investors expected a stronger outlook.
english_outline.section_2_business_changes: Data Center revenue reached $6.7B, up 107% YoY, driven by EPYC CPUs and Instinct GPUs. Client revenue rose 23% to $3.1B. Gaming fell 31% to $779M. Embedded rose 19% to $977M. Helios rack-scale solution launched with customers including Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle.
english_outline.section_3_expectations: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to ~$13B, up 41% YoY, above LSEG consensus of $12.52B. Non-GAAP gross margin expected at 56%. CEO Lisa Su said Data Center sales would more than double in 2027, with total revenue growth above 35% target and annual EPS above $20 goal.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing: Reuters reported shares fell nearly 9% in extended trading. Emarketer analyst Jacob Bourne said investors seek evidence AI infrastructure investments translate into accelerating returns. Data Center revenue beat expectations of $6.48B. Adjusted EPS of $1.66 beat estimate of $1.62.
english_outline.section_5_verification_points: Key Q3 verification: Helios rack-scale shipments, MI400 series GPU ramp, EPYC demand acceleration, and whether Data Center revenue growth sustains the pace needed to meet 2027 targets.

reader_questions: 稿件称数据中心营收环比增长16.3%，但官方新闻稿只给出同比增长107%和占总营收58%，这个环比数字来自哪里、是否与官方口径一致？
稿件把“数据中心销售额2027年翻倍以上、总营收增长超35%、年度盈利超每股20美元”写成苏姿丰在本次财报电话会上的表述，这些目标是否属于本次Q2财报的官方指引？
稿件称股价盘后下跌近9%，但同一来源的标题写的是“stock reverses after hours”，跌幅与“反转”表述是否一致，应如何呈现？
checks: 核对官方新闻稿：Segment Summary仅列数据中心营收67亿美元、同比增长107%，未披露环比增速；环比16.3%及一季度57.8亿美元仅见于路透社报道，属媒体测算口径，修订稿须标注来源并避免与官方数据混列。
核对官方新闻稿：Current Outlook仅给出2026年第三季度营收约130亿美元±3亿美元、非GAAP毛利率约56%；35%营收增长与每股20美元盈利目标系2025年分析师日设定，2027年数据中心翻倍属电话会表述，均非本次官方指引，须降级为电话会口径并注明出处。
核对路透社报道：正文明确“shares fell nearly 9% in extended trading”，而Investing.com另一篇标题为“stock reverses after hours”，两者对盘后走势描述不一致；修订稿只保留路透社的“盘后下跌近9%”，并说明该跌幅来自单一媒体报道。
